note: Both sets share the same misread of "8D RING SHANK NAIL" as "8 8D" and both duplicate several claims, but Set A keeps more of the page's substantive envelope and structure facts correct (continuous sealant with its manufacturer condition, continuous waterproofing, adjustable scaffold footing, 3/4" exterior grade plywood, plate hole spacing at 12" O.C., W10 x 15 section). Set A's main faults are two misbindings (W10 x 15 merged into "steel decking", and 1'-4 3/4" attributed to the RAILING ATTACHMENT/Detail C1 when it is a segment in the A3 module connection) plus the garbled entity "ank nail". Set B adds good fastener facts (3" wood lag screw with washer, 3/8" x 4" hex through bolt, 7/16" plate hole diameter) but invents conditions and connections for the railing post bracket ("connection to joist", "connection | frame"), misbinds 3/4" to deck thickness with an unsupported quote fragment, and calls 5'-2 1/2" railing post spacing. Overall Set A is somewhat more faithful and better conditioned, though the gap is modest.
